facts.business: Majestic Auto Limited is a commercial real estate company focused on rental yielding office space leasing and facility management in Noida and New Delhi, and also conducts treasury operations through investments in financial instruments.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Utilize borrowed funds only to enhance return on equity in rental yielding commercial real estate assets and to look for higher yield asset opportunities.

key_risks: Concentration risk from large investment in a single stock (Hero MotoCorp) historically
Market volatility impacting treasury operations and fair value of financial instruments
Dependence on rental income from commercial real estate assets
facts.related_party_note: Security deposits include amounts with related parties (refer Note 36 for details).
